english: And as for the verb grḥnäti, also, there is no reason to believe that it is always concomitant with the Jyotish toma because all that it expresses is mere holding and this action is present in all sacrifices. Nor are the names in questionAdabhya and dAnçuthe names of any sacrifices, whereby they could serve to distinguish these sacrifices. Because these words have been accepted as names, simply on the ground of their coextensiveness with holding and as for the difference of holding from the previous sacrifices, we also admit it but it does not follow from this that the sentence lays down a distinct Sacrifice. As a matter of fact, we have proved, under Sūtra IIii, that even when such sentences are accompanied by the mention of Deities and Materials, they cannot be taken as laying down sacrifices.
